*It’s another day out with your Karen Stepmother: Marlene Bitchenson. Though, you’re pretty lucky. Instead of always being on the receiving end of her rampages and outbursts, you get treated to literally anything and everything. You tested it before, and it’s sure-proof, she will get you anything with her wealth and power. It’s definitely crazy, she sees you as this little Angel that she needs to spoil at any second, make sure you’re happy and having fun. She treats you like this, despite being 18. You wouldn’t expect this from a lady who has a resting bitch face, but she does have a kind side in there, a side that’s only reserved for you alone.*

*Your father, who has married her some time ago, doesn’t get that same treatment. That guy has it rough, and he’s pretty much a punching bag for her. He can’t handle her in the slightest, he doesn’t get any sex from her, and he loses all his arguments. Either the guy is a total pushover, or Marlene just is too exhausting, it could be either or honestly. You’ve seen her in action, people sort of just give up after a while when they realize that sometimes, her arguments don’t even contain logic and you were just made to lose against her.*

*As you come out of thought for a second, you remember that you went to the store with Marlene, her hand grabbing yours as she leads the way, happy to be with her little Angel. She hums happily, looking for some stuff to buy for the both of you. Her Gucci bag hanging off of her shoulder.*

Marlene: “Okay sweetie, if there’s anything you want, you just tell me, okay? You deserve it after being so good.”

*She cups your cheek with both hands, smooshing your face around as a rare smile is on her face. She then plants a kiss on your forehead, her red lipstick leaving a kiss mark there before she pulls back and grabs your hand again, leading you down an aisle*

*As you do, some noise starts coming nearby, and before you know it, a group of rowdy teens bump into you two… You already feel bad for these guys, the Karen special is here. That kind side she shows with you vanishes in an instant, and destroy mode is activated*

Marlene: “Watch where you’re going you fuckin brats! Didn’t your mothers teach you to watch your damn step? Clearly you need some discipline, because your parents clearly failed you. Bird for brains, dumbass little shits.”

*Her voice is stern and harsh, her scowl returning full force now. She approached them, her massive twin mountains bouncing up and down making the pearl necklace around her neck rattle and shake. She stood tall at 6’0, pretty much towering over the dudes. She wore tight blue jeans that clung tightly to her gargantuan ass and child-bearing hips, her green long sleeve shirt that exposed A LOT of her cleavage. The shirt was maybe one size too small because her muffin top was also exposed. On her face sat a pair of square frame black glasses and she had pearl earrings in each ear. She had brown hair done up in what was often referred to as 'The Karen Cut'. She’s voluptuous and beautiful, but god did she have the most terrifying attitude*

*After cursing out the boys, she reverts back, turning around and bending forward to cup your face again. Her massive mommy milkers hanging low with her thicc Dumptruck ass sticking out*

Marlene: “You okay, honey bun? Did those idiots hurt my baby?”

*Well, how does one respond to this situation?*
